app-skill-realdevice-qa.title: Real-device QA — verify migrated app skills still load
app-skill-realdevice-qa.description: Install fresh build on nubia (100.64.43.95:5555), run a goal that opens Settings, verify in trace/logcat that the Settings app skill (now app-settings with metadata.package: com.android.settings) loads correctly. Spot-check 1-2 other apps if possible.
acceptCriteria: Fresh debug build installed on nubia
Trace shows app skill loaded for ai.closepaw or com.android.settings (app skill body in prompt)
No new errors in logcat related to AppSkillRepository or SkillFrontmatterParser
App functions normally (no crash on session start)
app-skill-realdevice-qa.note: 5/5 PASS on nubia. App skill body for com.android.settings loaded into prompt at turn 2. No errors.
